ns2:section.sectionText: International Water Project: Real-World Design- Two-semester course (Fa17 and Sp18) to assist a rural Honduran community in designing and implementing a holistic water system. This section is for graduate students who plan to participate in the Honduras section of the course. You will work closely with professional mentors on every stage of the project and have the opportunity to travel to Honduras during Winter Break 2018. LAS Graduate Students who wish to take this course and travel to Honduras should enroll in this section. Crosslisted with ENG/LAST 440
